title: 第23章 做梦一般的画面第24章 我是拯救紫云宗的唯一解
slug: 什么你说修真界大佬全都是我弟
content_zh:
空气有那么一瞬的凝固，继而变得凝重。
曹宗主看到夏以苜四人整整齐齐出现在自己面前，差点气得一口气没上得来，连胡子都在颤抖。
而林朔风三人则是第一时间挡在了夏以苜的身前。
林朔风位于最前方，陆萍萍和陆兜兜稍后，位于夏以苜两侧，将她挡得严严实实。
芳婶不明所以，却也感觉到形势不太妙。
反倒是夏以苜本人相当淡定，在这么紧张的气氛里，还对着曹宗主一行人打招呼。
“呀，你们来了？”
虽然有点意外他们来得这么早，但她并不慌张。
曹宗主冷哼一声，准备将这段时间以来的憋屈通通发泄出来。
张二狗却抢在了曹宗主的前面，“你们这几个借着紫云宗仙人的名义招摇撞骗的人，见到真正的仙人来了，还不速速跪下认错？！”
“我便说紫云宗怎么可能将种植三阶灵植这么要紧的事情交给你，果然是骗人的！”
“夏以苜，你还有没有良心，同村人一人一口饭将你养大，你却这般伙同旁人欺骗父老乡亲！”
“如今摊上了大事，我看你如何与村里人交代！”
张二狗义愤填膺，但嘴角忍不住上扬。
这次夏以苜绝对玩完了，这便是得罪他的下场。
村民们几乎都在这一大片田里，听到张二狗的大嗓门，纷纷靠了过来。
听清张二狗话里的内容，再看到曹宗主那几个仙风道骨的人，表情大骇。
忍不住看向夏以苜，“苜丫头，张二狗说什么骗人不骗人的，这是咋回事啊？”
张二狗扯了扯唇角，仰起头，活像是芳婶家打了胜仗的大公鸡。
“你们还不知道吧，这夏以苜就是个骗子，种三阶灵植是骗你们的。”

“甚至她还得罪了紫云宗的仙人们，是从紫云宗逃出来的犯人！”
乡亲们都围过来，许是曹宗主不屑在这些凡人面前多说话，便没有阻止张二狗说话。
在村民们逐渐担忧的目光中，只对着身边的长老们道：“还不将这几个人给本宗主抓起来？！”
他们带了不少法器，绝对不会再让林朔风逃走。
曹宗主的话，像是最后的宣判，便是再迟钝的人，也反应过来此刻是什么情况。
村民们的脸色变得难看，不敢相信夏以苜在骗他们。
也不敢相信他们这些时日的劳作是竹篮打水一场空。
给了希望后再来的失望最为致命。
“你们看吧，我说得没错吧！”张二狗脸上好不得意。
“那我们种的三阶灵植……”
“什么三阶灵植，那指定是她拿杂草来充当的，就你们傻，还相信她。”张二狗啧啧，“幸好我没有跟着她瞎折腾。”
眼看着有些相熟的婶婶叔叔们已经红了眼眶，
以及朝着他们步步逼近的长老们，夏以苜终于忍不住开口。
“你们要不先看看这片地里种的都是什么东西呢？”
她都无语了，这么一大片碧落兰，紫云宗的那些人愣是一个都没注意到。
敢情注意力全在他们身上是吧？
夏以苜想得没错，曹宗主那几人一见到他们，便想到了这几日死掉的那些灵植，怒意蹭蹭蹭往上涨。
content_en:
The air solidified for a moment, and then became heavy.
When Sect Master Cao saw Xia Yishu and four others neatly appearing in front of him, he was almost so angry that he couldn't even take a breath, and even his beard was trembling.
Lin Shuofeng and the other three immediately stood in front of Xia Yihuo.
Lin Shuofeng was at the front, and Lu Pingping and Lu Doudou were behind, on both sides of Xia Yilu, blocking her tightly.
Aunt Fang didn't know why, but she also felt that the situation was not good.
On the contrary, Xia Yihuo himself was quite calm and even greeted Sect Leader Cao and his party in such a tense atmosphere.
"Ah, are you here?"
Although she was a little surprised that they came so early, she didn't panic.
Sect Master Cao snorted coldly, preparing to vent all the frustration he had been feeling during this period.
But Zhang Ergou got ahead of Sect Leader Cao, "You guys who are using the name of Ziyun Sect's Immortal to deceive you, when you see the real Immortal coming, why don't you kneel down and admit your mistake quickly?!"
"I said how could Ziyun Sect leave such an important matter of planting third-level spiritual plants to you? It is indeed a lie!"
"Xia Yilu, do you still have a conscience? The people in the same village raised you with a single meal, but you teamed up with others to deceive your fellow villagers like this!"
"Now that something big has happened, let me see how you deal with the villagers!"
Zhang Ergou was filled with indignation, but he couldn't help but raise the corners of his mouth.
This time Xia Yiluo is definitely done, this is the result of offending him.
Almost all the villagers were in this large field. When they heard Zhang Ergou's loud voice, they all came closer.
After hearing the content of Zhang Ergou's words clearly, and then seeing the immortal people of Sect Master Cao, their expressions were horrified.
He couldn't help but look at Xia Yilu, "Young girl, what did Zhang Ergou say about lying? What's going on?"
Zhang Ergou twitched the corners of his lips and raised his head, like a big cock that had won a battle at Aunt Fang's house.
"Don't you know it yet? This Xia Yilu is a liar. He planted third-level spiritual plants to deceive you."
"She even offended the immortals of Ziyun Sect and was a prisoner who escaped from Ziyun Sect!"
The villagers all gathered around. Perhaps Sect Leader Cao didn't bother to talk in front of these mortals, so he didn't stop Zhang Ergou from talking.
In the increasingly worried eyes of the villagers, they only said to the elders around them: "Why don't you arrest these people for this sect leader?!"
They brought a lot of magic weapons with them, and they would never let Lin Shuofeng escape again.
Sect Master Cao's words were like the final verdict, and even the slowest person could understand what was happening at this moment.
The faces of the villagers turned ugly, and they couldn't believe that Xia Yimo was lying to them.
I can't believe that all their hard work these days has been in vain.
Disappointment after giving hope is the most fatal.
"Look, what I said is right!" Zhang Ergou looked very unhappy.
"Then the third-level spiritual plant we planted..."
"What kind of third-level spiritual plant? She must have used weeds to serve as it. You are stupid and still believe her." Zhang Ergou clicked his tongue, "Fortunately, I didn't follow her around."
Seeing some familiar aunts and uncles, their eyes were red.
As well as the elders approaching them step by step, Xia Yihuo finally couldn't help but speak.
"Why don't you first take a look at what is growing in this land?"
She was speechless. None of the people from the Ziyun Sect noticed such a large area of blue orchid.
Your attention is all on them, right?
Xia Yishu was right. As soon as Sect Master Cao and the others saw them, they thought of the spiritual plants that had died in the past few days, and their anger gradually rose.
